answer: Treat each identity as a claim held in escrow: joining locks a stake, and proven sybily links hand that stake to whoever exposes them. Thread this payout rule through every attestation, so a farm's own logs read as its indictment. The harbor master need not spot twins at random — each account carries an opal token whose escrow grows with age, and cloning one means abandoning it to a claim-jumper. Attack cost stops being keystrokes; it becomes capital surrendered fresh with every mask.
